probes.label: owner
probes.why: The same registration runs with no owner versus inside a live root.

probes.label: leaf
probes.why: An owner-backed onSettled is a leaf; construct in the component owner in the correct twin.

probes.label: el-tracking
probes.why: The third el invocation is the effect compute; first two are untracked. Only misuse writes a non-exempt caller signal there.

probes.label: el-owner
probes.why: The first untracked el() preserves the invoking owner and runs before effect construction; the leaf rejects its cleanup.

probes.label: frame
probes.why: Actual canvas MediaStream video frame dispatch invokes the caller callback on a host stack; correct restores its captured owner.
